name: Nongshim Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nongshim Holdings Co.,Ltd. together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, imports, exports, and sells food products and consumer goods in South Korea, China, the United Stated, Canada, Japan, Australia, and Vietnam. It provides instant noodles, snacks, and beverages. The company also processes agricultural and marine products, as well as manufactures soup powder; manufactures and sells food processing equipment; offers engineering related services; and operates golf club. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
